cohort: All cesarean sections performed at Obio Cottage Hospital in 2018
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 32.4%, with Robson groups 1, 2, and 5 accounting for the majority of cases, highlighting the need to review labor management and trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) practices.
mod_finding: The study found that 70.49% of women in Robson group 5 (previous Cesarean section) underwent a Cesarean section, highlighting the need to increase the number of women offered a trial of labor after a Cesarean birth.
